'''Plasrock''' was a construction material which was used in the ceilings of buildings.<ref name="DN2">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref> In [[36 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' establishes that the [[Star Wars: The Dark Nest Trilogy|''Dark Nest'' trilogy]] begins in [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]] and ends in [[36 BBY]], while the text of ''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]'' dates its events to one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after those of ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'', the first book of the trilogy. Therefore, the events of ''The Unseen Queen'' take place in 36 BBY.</ref> [[Queen Mother]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka's]] [[Royal Bedchamber|nursery]], within her [[Fountain Palace|palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], had a ceiling composed of plasrock. [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of the [[Gorog]] nest, hired to [[Attempted assassination of Allana Solo|assassinate]] the Queen Mother's [[Allana Djo Solo|daughter]], penetrated the ceiling in an effort to enter the nursery, causing the plasrock to fall in fragments.<ref name="DN2" />
